text: In the fall of 1799, the New York constable Ichabod Crane arrives in the upstate Dutch village of Sleepy Hollow to investigate a string of decapitations, which the elders blame on [the undead apparition of a headless Hessian mercenary|threat|the dead that rise]. Lodging with the wealthy Van Tassels, he falls for Katrina, who keeps [a book of charms|rules|faith and charms protect]. In the Western Woods he digs up [the Hessian's grave at the tree of the dead|images|plants, trees and fungus] and finds the skull missing, while every victim proves tied to [a secret will and a rich estate|wants|wealth and ambition].
